titleEn: Rethinking dry-off on a high-performing Kerry herd
titleZh: 凯里郡高产奶牛群的干奶策略再思考
summaryZh: 爱尔兰凯里郡的奶农Maurice Harty经营着平均产奶量超10,000升的纯种荷斯坦弗里西亚牛群。他改变了传统干奶方式，采用Elanco AHV公司的StopLac产品实现突然干奶，使奶牛在干奶前可维持每日两次挤奶直至决定干奶当天，从而延长产奶期约两周，获得高价值的高固形物牛奶，同时奶牛能以良好体况进入干奶期。文章还强调了外部顾问对牛群健康管理的重要性。
featuredReason: 本文展示了传统干奶流程的革新实践，通过使用StopLac产品实现突然干奶，延长高产奶牛产奶期并改善动物福利，对追求高效精准牧场管理的智慧畜牧从业者具有参考价值。
contentFull: Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Sponsored Rethinking dry-off on a high-performing Kerry herd ![Image 1: Agriland Team By Agriland Team September 5, 2026 5:00 AM](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsauthoragriland-team) Share this article ![Image 2: Kevin Quilter Elanco (AHV) with customer Maurice Harty, Ballylongane Pedigree Holstein Friesians. ](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsrethinking-dry-off-on-a-high-performing-kerry-herd) Kevin Quilter Elanco (AHV) with customer Maurice Harty, Ballylongane Pedigree Holstein Friesians. Sponsored by !Image 3 For Co. Kerry dairy farmer Maurice Harty, getting the most from a high-performing cow starts with making the most of the genetics in the herd. At Ballylongane Pedigree Holstein Friesians, the Harty family has been breeding pedigree cows since 1967, with the herd fully pedigree registered since 1983. Today, the herd averages more than 10,000L, with average solids of 4.30% fat and 3.50% protein. Maurice said: “You have to look after the genetics that you have, feed them to their potential and keep them healthy. Anything that can enhance that, I suppose, I’m interested in.” Maurice has been an AHV, now Elanco AHV, customer for the past five years and works with herd consultant Kevin Quilter to improve herd health, performance and profitability. “If they calve down well and hit the ground running, you’re straight into production rather than hoping that they’ll come on. "On the fertility side, they show stronger heats faster and they go back in calf again. And I like that sort of approach,” Maurice said. More recently, he has also changed how he dries cows off Still giving 16–23L at dry-off At Ballylongane, cows approaching dry-off can still be producing between 16L and 23Lday. Previously, Maurice batched cows together for dry-off, sometimes once a month, and restricted their diet in advance to help bring production down. ![Image 4](https:images.agriland.iezZP6jyelF-8Qu-mjXFLH-cwsXSVrI0iumo6NlTeG694rs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202609mh3-crop.png) The Co. Kerry farmer explained: “In the old method for drying off cows, I was sort of batching cows, maybe drying cows once a month. "So you might have some cows that would be dry too long, and some cows that wouldn’t be dry long enough. “We would keep them on a restricted diet for another week after that. "So in total that was nearly 10 to 14 days of a drying-off period, after which your cow was a bit shook and a bit lonesome looking at that stage.” ![Image 5](https:images.agriland.ieKJN4jUXydOj7nIGHdiSaQX5U8IsAe86LGMpltby9044rs:fit:911:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202609mh2.png) It also meant drying cows off earlier while they were still milking well. “I always just felt that the cows had lost a lot, and it took a while to bring them back up to where they were. “At that, you would have to dry them off a bit earlier than you would like, and you’re losing milk," he said. 'Milked twice a day until it’s time to dry her off' Maurice first tried StopLac on a batch of cows. StopLac supports abrupt dry-off by quickly and temporarily reducing milk production, allowing normal feeding and milking to be maintained right up to dry-off. Maurice said: “With the StopLac, the herd will be milked twice a day until you decide, right, it’s time to dry her off. “All I do is just tube them, drive them straight into the crush, give them the StopLac, and out into the dry cow house.” It has also changed when Maurice dries cows off. “I can get at least two weeks' extra milk from the cow at the end of her lactation, with high solids, which is high-value milk. “The dry cow is making nothing for you, whereas if you can leave a cow milking for another two weeks, she’s making money for you," he said. For Maurice, keeping cows well fed right through to dry-off is also important. “The cow is in great condition going into the dry cow house,” he said. “If you are a 10,000L cow, or whatever you are above the 5,000L cow, you have to support that cow to that on nutrition.” Another set of eyes on the herd Maurice is also open to outside opinions on how the herd is performing. He said: “It’s always important for an outsider to come in and look at the herd, even if it’s only for five minutes. ![Image 6](https:images.agriland.ieo9LyKdMBblDdahE9nWV8T9BOfi5LukCKDoL38X0s4rs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202609mh1.png) “The vet, or the likes of Kevin from Elanco AHV, or maybe in my case there’d be a judge or two coming in during the year, or anyone else. “You would always like someone would give their honest opinion of what the herd looked like on the day, and you can drive on or correct it.” After first trying StopLac with a batch of cows, Maurice has since used it across the whole herd. “I intend to use it across the whole herd this year anyway, because I like what I see, and I like the results," the Co. Kerry farmer said. translationZh:
对于凯里郡奶农Maurice Harty来说，充分发挥高产奶牛的潜力始于充分利用牛群中的遗传基因。在Ballylongane纯种荷斯坦弗里西亚牛场，Harty家族自1967年以来一直从事纯种牛的繁育，牛群自1983年起完全注册为纯种。如今，该牛群平均产奶量超过10,000升，平均乳脂率4.30%，乳蛋白率3.50%。

Maurice表示：“你必须照顾好你所拥有的遗传基因，将其喂养到其潜力水平，并保持它们的健康。任何能够增强这一点的东西，我想，我都感兴趣。”

Maurice成为AHV（现为Elanco AHV）的客户已有五年，并与牛群顾问Kevin Quilter合作，以改善牛群健康、生产性能和盈利能力。

“如果它们产犊顺利并立即进入状态，你就能直接进入生产阶段，而不是指望它们慢慢恢复。在繁殖方面，它们表现出更强、更快的发情迹象，并能再次成功受孕。我喜欢这种方法，”Maurice说。

最近，他还改变了奶牛干奶的方式。

**干奶时仍日产16-23升**

在Ballylongane，接近干奶的奶牛每天仍可产奶16升至23升。此前，Maurice将奶牛分批干奶，有时每月一次，并提前限制日粮以帮助降低产量。

这位凯里郡的农场主解释说：“在旧的干奶方法中，我倾向于分批处理，可能每月干奶一次。这样可能会导致一些奶牛干奶期过长，而另一些则干奶期不足。之后我们还会对它们进行为期一周的限制饲喂。所以总共大约有10到14天的干奶期，在那之后，你的奶牛会有点虚弱，看起来也有点萎靡。”

这也意味着在奶牛产奶量仍然很高时就需要提前干奶。“我总觉得奶牛损失了很多，需要一段时间才能恢复到原来的状态。而且，你不得不比预期更早地给它们干奶，从而损失了牛奶产量，”他说。

**“每天挤两次奶，直到决定给她干奶为止”**

Maurice首先在一批奶牛上尝试了StopLac。StopLac通过快速、暂时地减少产奶量来支持突然干奶，允许在干奶前维持正常的饲喂和挤奶。

Maurice说：“使用StopLac，牛群会每天挤两次奶，直到你决定，好了，是时候给她干奶了。我所要做的就是给它们投药，直接把它们赶进保定栏，给它们用上StopLac，然后它们就进入干奶牛舍。”

这也改变了Maurice决定干奶的时间。“我可以在奶牛泌乳期末期至少多获得两周的牛奶，且具有高固形物含量，这是高价值的牛奶。干奶牛不会为你创造任何价值，而如果你能让奶牛再多挤两周奶，她就在为你赚钱，”他说。

对Maurice来说，让奶牛在干奶前保持良好的饲养状态也很重要。“奶牛进入干奶牛舍时体况非常好，”他说。“如果你是一头产奶量10,000升的奶牛，或者无论你比产奶量5,000升的奶牛高出多少，你都必须通过营养来支持这头奶牛。”

**为牛群增添另一双眼睛**

Maurice也乐于接受外部人士对牛群表现的意见。他说：“让外人来看看牛群总是很重要的，哪怕只看五分钟。兽医，或者像来自Elanco AHV的Kevin这样的人，或者以我的情况，一年中可能还会有一两位评审员来，或者其他任何人。你总是希望有人能诚实地评价当天牛群的外观，然后你可以据此改进或纠正。”

在首批尝试了StopLac之后，Maurice已将其用于整个牛群。“无论如何，我今年打算在整个牛群中使用它，因为我喜欢我所看到的效果，也喜欢这些结果，”这位凯里郡的农场主说。
